summary:
Swept 7 repos read-only. Two contain reusable engineering; the rest are irrelevant or empty.
(1) hihi@claude/voice-notes-app-calendar-f0d541 'Echo' is an Expo SDK57/RN voice-notes app with SQLite local-first storage + Supabase (RLS, private storage, Deno edge functions). It is a carefully reasoned prototype: CI typechecks and bundles both platforms, but there are 0 tests and 0 device measurements.
Reusable patterns from Echo: single-mic-stream capture (transcript + WAV), Android silence auto-restart with segment offsets, finalise-on-both-signals plus a 4s watchdog, dirty-local-wins LWW sync, append-only user_version migrations, per-verb RLS with uid-prefixed private storage, reading media with the caller's JWT (never service role), OTP over magic links, a flat non-nullable structured-output schema, client re-validation of model JSON, and one-accent-one-meaning tokens.
Other hihi branches: prime-sum/codex is maths research. Its SESSION-LOG gives verification rejections (except-ImportError masked gate, determinism mistaken for correctness, CI never ran, soundness-not-sharpness) and a misconception-first explainer format. pranawatt gives honest-fail calculator tests and a Reveal component. ncr gives provenance rules.
(2) naukri_bi_copilot is a 14-step metadata-first BI copilot (Next 16, Neo4j, Athena, Astra/Llama/OpenRouter). The best asset is model-writes-template / code-computes-numbers / validator-traces-every-narrative-number, ideal for parent reports.
Other naukri assets: allow-list context sanitiser, runId context cache, one-retry-with-validator-feedback loop, static SQL validator, and ESLint no-restricted-imports as a safety boundary (use it to enforce the Azure-only directive).
naukri rejections: silent mock fallbacks, in-process memory, 18-request client pipeline, auth removed.
(3) routine_carbonsettle_intel: 29 one-file branches of daily CBAM briefings, each written to an unmerged branch, so 29/29 runs had no memory of prior runs. This is a key rejection for the Conductor/day cycle.
(4) vyakti-product: main is a 2023 static portfolio. Its claude/ai-companion-app-rkt1lv branch is a shallow 60-commit Meera copy (2026-08-18..20) superseded by html-portfolio; its commit bodies yielded ~20 high-value rejections (missing age-tier safety rule on the realtime lane, invalid workflow for 9 days, dead writers, never-scheduled, shared prod/research key) and a TRANSFER.md move manifest useful for the Vercel->Azure move.
(5) shivaji_sarthi (PDA-Saathi) is a mock-only dashboard (only the Hindi/English i18n + Devanagari font is reusable; ~350/399 files are committed .next output). vyakti-products has 0 commits; sales-enabler is .gitkeep-only on all 4 refs (confirmed).

assets.title: Echo single-stream voice capture hook
assets.what: One recogniser session yields live transcript + persisted WAV; transparent Android silence restart (cap 12) with session-offset segment timings; finalise only after both end and audioend; 4s stop watchdog; no-speech suppressed in continuous mode; describeError maps codes to human messages.
assets.taxila_target: realtime-voice / android-capacitor mic fallback, offline voice-note-to-teacher
assets.evidence: CI typecheck+bundle only; no device test
assets.notes: RN-specific; port patterns not code. Azure STT instead of platform recogniser if needed.

assets.title: sqrt volume normalisation for live waveform
assets.what: Maps recogniser -2..10 level to 0..1 via sqrt(clamp(v,0,8)/8) because speech sits at 1-4; 100ms live, 250ms stored samples, 42-bar trail.
assets.taxila_target: child-facing 'teacher is listening' meter

assets.title: Long-silence recogniser settings for thinking pauses

assets.taxila_target: child pause tolerance in any STT/VAD fallback

rejections.tried: Daily scheduled CBAM briefing agent meant to tag [UPDATE] items against prior briefings and de-duplicate

Memory feature dead for 4 weeks, unnoticed because each output looked fine.

rejections.what_broke: At audit vector/query/embeddings were all mock and both LLMs degraded, yet the loop 'completes end-to-end' -- a pass says nothing about the real system.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Fallbacks must be loud; tag served lane per response and assert it in evals; no mock reachable in prod.
